name: Chaos Warp
clause: The owner of target permanent shuffles it into their library, then reveals the top card of their library. If it's a permanent card, they put it onto the battlefield.

needs.proposedSignature: Condition: { kind: 'that-matches', filter: Filter, of?: Ref }  // holds when the bound object (default `that`) matches the filter
needs.semantics: A condition that tests the CURRENT BINDING against an ordinary Filter, so 'if it's a creature card', 'if it's a Spirit', 'if that creature has haste', 'if it's a permanent card' become `conditional` branches instead of unexpressible clauses. Filter already carries types / subtypes / withKeyword / notKeywords / mvLE, so nothing new is needed on the filter side; only the condition variant and its resolution through refs.ts. A companion `{ kind: 'self-matches', filter }` covers '…and ~ doesn't'.
needs.clause: If it's a creature card, you gain life equal to that card's toughness … / If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it. / If that creature has haste and ~ doesn't, put a haste counter on ~.
